_source: asdair.shop_question, shop id 33 (SHOP-2026-08-17, source_kind=photo), read as asdair_ro and transcribed into the Work Order WO-2026-08-18-03 by Larry on 2026-08-18.
_why_this_is_in_git: A defect nobody can reproduce without database credentials is a defect nobody can fix. Household shopping content is explicitly committable to this public repository (GL-009 'Household operations content'); Warwick has ruled it three times. There are no credentials, ids or personal identifiers here - product names and his own words about groceries.
_what_happened: Nine questions were opened in ONE planning pass. Seven answers were written between 18:19:19.475Z and 18:19:21.938Z - 2.5 seconds, ~350ms apart, a batch and not a man typing. The first THREE bound correctly. From the fourth on each answer landed on the question ABOVE the one it answers, and two were never recorded at all.

_reading_the_columns.answerText: verbatim from the row - Warwick's own words - or null where nothing was ever recorded
_reading_the_columns.answersQuestion: the ordinal of the question these words ACTUALLY answer, where that is unarguable from the text; null where it is not
_reading_the_columns.establishment: established | ambiguous | not-established | never-recorded. ONLY 'established' rows may be used to judge a mis-bind. The ambiguous ones are honest and must NOT be resolved to make a cleaner test.
